name: Easy Auto Tag & Insurance
category: Auto tags, title, insurance, and notary
hours: Mon to Fri 10 am to 5 pm. Sat 11 am to 4 pm.
description: Easy Auto Tag & Insurance on East Girard Avenue in Philadelphia handles tag and title service, registration renewals, car insurance, notary work, and instant registrations for ATVs, boats, and motorcycles.

hero.headline: Tags, insurance, a desk that is open
hero.sub: Tag and title work, registration renewals, car insurance, and notary service at 538 E Girard Ave, six days a week.

offerings.heading: Done at the <mark>counter.</mark>
items: Tag and title service, transfers, and vehicle registration renewal
Car insurance quoted and bound while you wait
Notary public, driver's license renewal, and instant registrations for ATVs, boats, and motorcycles
Mon to Fri 10 to 5, Sat 11 to 4

story.heading: The desk that finishes the errand
paragraphs: Easy Auto Tag & Insurance sits on East Girard Avenue in Fishtown, where a title transfer, a plate, and an insurance card can all get done in one stop instead of three.
Saturday hours exist because most people cannot take a weekday off for a registration. Bring the documents, leave with the tag.

experience.heading: What to bring
items: Title or current registration, ID, and proof of insurance.
For a new policy, the vehicle details; quotes happen at the desk.
Notary work for auto and personal documents, same visit.

feature.heading: Instant registrations
feature.text: ATVs, boats, and motorcycles get registered on the spot, along with cars and trucks, for anyone in Pennsylvania.

closing.heading: Tags, title, insurance, and notary on Girard Avenue
